headline: Ray J’s ex-wife, Princess Love, walks in on him and Celina Powell inside Princess’ home. O
body: Ray J’s ex-wife, Princess Love, walks in on him and Celina Powell inside Princess’ home. On Wednesday (Nov. 25), Zeus Network and Zeus’ cofounder shared footage of the incident on Instagram. Ray was on livestream with Celina at Princess’ house when the drama popped off after Ray and Celina went into a bathroom to talk things over.
